neighbours.label: ' son' as the first piece of a longer split word (sonar, sonido, sonnette)
fire: The submarine used its sonar to find the wreck on the sea floor.
El técnico midió el nivel de sonido en la sala de conciertos.
Dolphins rely on a kind of natural sonar to hunt in murky water.
Elle a tiré sur la sonnette avant d'entrer dans la maison.
La guitarra tiene un tono muy sonoro y cálido.
The fishing boat carries a small sonar unit to locate schools of fish.
Los sonidos de la ciudad no la dejaban dormir por la noche.
Bats and whales both evolved sonar long before humans built it.
quiet: The submarine used its radar to find the ship on the sea surface.

notes: Card: ' son' x6 of top 32, each the start of a longer word (son|ido, son|nette, son|ar); also katakana リ/チ in Japanese. Tokenizer checked: ' sonar', ' sonido', ' sonnette', ' sonoro' all split as ' son' + rest. Near misses swap in a word without that piece.
